purpose: Guarantee that every published annual population change is exactly explained by births, deaths, net migration and explicit scenario effects.
requiredChecks: for every municipality and FA, annual change equals births - deaths + net migration + scenario effect
population at year t equals population at year t-1 plus reported annual change
baseline scenario effect is exactly zero
the identity holds with active housing and workplace scenarios
the identity holds for every supported forecast year in the ten-year horizon
governance: Accounting identity is a hard production invariant, independent of forecast accuracy.
Any future demographic component must enter the identity explicitly rather than changing population invisibly.
